answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued monthly at 2 days per month. (Leave Policy v2.8, 1. Annual leave)
Up to 10 unused annual leave days can be carried forward into the next year. (Leave Policy v2.8, 2. Carry forward)
Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year. (Leave Policy v2.8, 3. Sick leave)
Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave. (Leave Policy v2.8, 4. Parental leave)
Employees on hybrid contracts work from the office at least 3 days per week and may work from home up to 2 days per week. (Hybrid and Remote Work Policy v1.9, 1. Hybrid schedule)

Hybrid employees can claim a one-time home-office setup allowance of INR 10,000 for a chair, desk or monitor, in addition to the annual equipment limit in the expense policy. (Hybrid and Remote Work Policy v1.9, 3. Home-office setup)
After confirmation the notice period is 60 days. (Employee Handbook v7.1, 4. Probation)
New employees serve a probation period of 6 months, during which the notice period is 15 days. (Employee Handbook v7.1, 4. Probation)
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. (Information Security Policy v5.3, 5. Passwords and MFA)
Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST. (Employee Handbook v7.1, 2. Working hours)
Standard application access is provisioned within 2 business days once the ticket is raised. (Software and Systems Access Policy v2.1, 3. Standard turnaround)

USB-C docking stations are provided to employees who work at a desk in the office at least 3 days per week. (Peripherals and Accessories Policy v1.2, 2. Docking stations)
Client entertainment: up to INR 5,000 per person, including the client guests; record the client's name. (Expense and Reimbursement Policy v6.0, 3. Meals and entertainment limits)
Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense. (Expense and Reimbursement Policy v6.0, 1. General principles)
Veridian Labs observes 12 public holidays per year; the list is published by HR each December. (Leave Policy v2.8, 5. Public holidays)
Performance reviews take place twice a year, in April and October. (Employee Handbook v7.1, 5. Performance reviews)
Working from another country for more than 14 days in a year requires prior approval from HR and Legal because of tax implications. (Hybrid and Remote Work Policy v1.9, 4. Working abroad)
Administrator or production access requires an additional review by IT Security and can take up to 5 business days. (Software and Systems Access Policy v2.1, 3. Standard turnaround)

Managers must request equipment and system access for a new hire at least 5 business days before the start date by raising an IT ticket with category onboarding. (New Hire Onboarding Policy v1.4, 1. Manager responsibilities)
